Noorika Emerald Statement Set

MOQ: 50 pcs
Enquire on WhatsApp

A celebration of refined royalty, this Noor Collection emerald AD set is designed for women who prefer elegance with presence. The necklace features bold emerald-toned centre stones framed by finely set AD crystals, arranged in a rhythmic, symmetrical layout that sits gracefully along the neckline. Delicate floral-inspired detailing softens the structure, creating a balance between strength and femininity. The matching earrings echo the same design language, with emerald centres highlighted by sparkling AD stones that catch the light effortlessly. The overall finish leans towards a silver-tone polish, enhancing the clarity of the stones and giving the set a timeless, heirloom-inspired appeal. This set pairs beautifully with evening wear, bridal looks, reception outfits, and modern couture ensembles. It’s striking without being overpowering, making it a versatile statement for both grand occasions and refined celebrations.
